title: [swarm-hard] Split this epic into independently verifiable tasks: "Users need to export their task history as CSV from the dashboard, and exports must be reviewed for PII leaks before release." Write one file per task under triage/epic-export/ named NN-<slug>.md (at least three), each starting with the lines `role:`, `title:`, `verify_cmd:` and containing a `## Scope` section. The set must include at least one backend, one frontend and one review task, and no two tasks may share a title.
verify_cmd:
python -c 'import pathlib, re
files = sorted(pathlib.Path("triage/epic-export").glob("[0-9][0-9]-*.md"))
assert len(files) >= 3, files
roles, titles = [], []
for f in files:
    text = f.read_text()
    head = dict(l.split(":", 1) for l in text.splitlines()[:6] if re.match(r"(role|title|verify_cmd):", l))
    assert set(head) == {"role", "title", "verify_cmd"} and head["verify_cmd"].strip(), f
    assert re.search(r"^## Scope\s*\n\s*\S", text, re.M), f
    roles.append(head["role"].strip()); titles.append(head["title"].strip().lower())
assert {"backend", "frontend", "review"} <= set(roles), roles
assert len(set(titles)) == len(titles)'
